title: Login Form CSRF Review
summary: A login or state-changing HTML form appears present without an obvious anti-CSRF token marker in the response body.
operator_questions: Does the rendered form include any hidden anti-CSRF token not visible in this captured response?
Does the application accept the same form submission from a cross-site origin without extra confirmation?

title: Session Cookie Hardening Review
summary: The response sets session cookies but appears to miss one or more hardening flags such as Secure, HttpOnly, or SameSite.
operator_questions: Are these cookies used for authenticated sessions or sensitive workflow state?
Does the application ever issue stronger cookie flags after login or privilege changes?

title: Browser Security Header Review
summary: Common browser hardening headers appear to be absent from the response.
operator_questions: Is this endpoint reachable in a browser context where missing clickjacking or MIME-sniff protections matter?

title: Identifier-Based Access Control Review
summary: Identifier-like parameter names suggest testing object-level authorization consistency across users or tenants.
operator_questions: Can you replay this request with another user's identifier while keeping the same session?
Is the identifier guessable, sequential, or leaked elsewhere in the application?

title: Admin Surface Access Control Review
summary: The request path looks administrative and should be checked for role enforcement and direct access bypass.
operator_questions: Does this path return different content for unauthenticated, low-privilege, and admin sessions?

title: Verbose Error Disclosure Review
summary: The response body preview contains framework or server error keywords that may expose internal details.
operator_questions: Can you reproduce the error consistently with malformed parameters or unexpected methods?
